definition: Eloquens, (commonly known under the alias Er Finestra) is a text-to-speech software, whose first version was released in 1993 by CSELT.
details: It was the first commercial speech synthesis software able to speak Italian.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Eloquens (software).
